name: ig-design-system
description: Infragistics design system: design tokens generated with igniteui-theming, plus the checks that keep sites consistent.

scripts.build: node src/make.mjs && node src/dtcg.mjs dist/tokens.json dist/theme.css dist/infragistics.tokens.json && node src/migration.mjs docs/MIGRATION.md && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/seed.js','dist/seed.js')"
scripts.check: node checks/lint.mjs reference/components && node checks/check-vars.mjs dist/tokens.css dist/theme.css reference && node checks/spacing-roles.mjs reference && node checks/gates-derived.cjs && node checks/gates-themes.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check
